name: dsh-web-search-openai
description: OpenAI-compatible Responses API search provider for the DeepSeek Harness web capability seam (ctx.web). Models and credentials are read from the DSH model configuration (settings + credentials store); the server search tool is auto-selected by model name (grok -> web_search [+x_search], 4o/4.1/preview -> web_search_preview, others -> web_search); auto/manual model chains with no-citation fallthrough.
